# Keystone Education Alliance — Operations & Finances

## Funding model
- **Annual operating budget:** **$6.8M** (FY27). Roughly: 45% foundation & government grants,
  35% individual & major gifts, 12% special events (the [gala](../projects/annual-gala-2026.md)),
  8% corporate & in-kind.
- **Restricted vs. unrestricted:** most grant money is **restricted** to a named program; only
  ~30% of revenue is **unrestricted** (the money the board can actually direct). Unrestricted gifts
  are the most valuable dollars Keystone raises — protect and grow them.
- **Reserve:** ~3.5 months operating reserve; board policy target is 6 months.
- **Largest single line:** the flagship [After-School Tutoring Program](../projects/after-school-tutoring.md),
  ~**$1.2M**/year, of which the restricted [Hearthstone grant](../projects/hearthstone-grant.md)
  historically covered about half.

## Budget & compliance rhythm
- **Fiscal year:** July 1 – June 30 (FY27 = Jul 2026 – Jun 2027).
- **Form 990** filed annually with the IRS; independent audit each fall; both reviewed by the
  board Finance Committee ([James Whitfield](../people/james-whitfield.md), chair).
- [Robert Kim](../people/robert-kim.md) owns the budget, audit, and 990; Cam is non-technical on
  finance and relies on him to translate.

## Key outcome metrics (what the board and funders track)
- **Program reach:** ~1,600 students served/year.
- **Tutoring outcomes:** % of students improving one+ grade level in reading/math per year
  (FY26: 71%).
- **College access:** % of Bright Futures seniors enrolling in college (FY26: 88%).
- **Cost per student served:** ~$4,250/year.
- **Donor retention:** individual-donor retention rate (FY26: 64%; board wants 70%+).
